items.description: The Supreme Student Council (Secondary Level) officially took their Oath of Office today, September 16, 2026, at Holy Deliverance Integrated Christian School. Guided by our School Directress/Principal, Dr. Ma. Theresa Dita Gracia Avendaño-Pitalbo, and supported by our SSC Adviser, Ms. Ellen Joy M. Florendo, our SSC Co-Adviser, Mr. Ian Russel A. Sanga, our fellow teachers, and our school, we pledge to lead with integrity, serve with passion, and amplify the voice of every student.
